resources.string: Bridge the split. Keep using your phone.
Connects the two sides of the screen around the damaged center.
Turns FoldPatch on again when you fold and unfold the phone.

You can install the apps and allow permissions on the cover screen with your phone folded. Unfold it when you reach screen area adjustment.\n\nPhysical-device testing was performed on a Samsung Galaxy Z Fold3 with Android 15 and One UI 7. Android 16 and 17 were tested only on emulators, not on physical devices.
Shizuku enables screen layout changes and touch forwarding. Start it with wireless debugging, then authorize FoldPatch. Start Shizuku again after restarting your phone.

Permission to display over other apps is required. Turning on FoldPatch uses Shizuku to connect the FoldPatch accessibility service and switch to the FoldPatch keyboard on your working touch side. Turning it off or folding the phone restores your previous keyboard.\n\nThe accessibility service displays the adjusted screen and handles touch gestures. The keyboard sends typed characters to the current text field. Screen content and typed text are not stored or sent to a server.
Return to settings and turn on FoldPatch. Unfold the phone and use “Adjust screen areas” to set both widths. A preview reverts after 15 seconds unless you save it.
Choose the side where touch works. Settings, keyboard, toolbar and touchpad move together. App content and screen areas stay the same.
Without confirmation, it reverts after 15 seconds. You can also change this on the cover screen.
How far the pointer moves for the same finger movement. Clicks and scrolling are unaffected.
Preview the layout and buttons as you change them. Changes are saved automatically.
Tap the handle to cycle: one button → selected buttons → all buttons → one button. Drag the handle to move the toolbar.
100% is the default. Buttons and text scale together.
Use the sliders on the ruler screen to set the visible area on each side.
Unfold the phone in portrait orientation and turn on FoldPatch first.
Use these options if the display looks wrong or the connection is lost.
If Shizuku has stopped, open Shizuku and tap Start. Start it again after restarting your phone too. Your saved screen areas stay available.

Turning off “Use FoldPatch” on the main settings screen stops the screen layout adjustment, touchpad and toolbar. Your apps, such as Chrome or YouTube, keep running.\n\nIf “Turn on when unfolded” is on, FoldPatch turns on again when you fold and unfold the phone.

Move the bright lines to the edges of the visible areas.
Save if all numbers are visible and the circles look round.
To change the areas, tap “Adjust again”.

Move your finger in the box below to move the pointer. Tap to increase the click count.

Displays the adjusted screen and routes physical touch to the original screen coordinates. The working side can act as a touchpad; toolbar and keyboard remain directly usable. It does not read screen content or typed text.
Typing supports Korean and English only. Changing the app language does not add input languages.
Left, Right and All refer to the screen area you control. %1$s uses normal touch. %2$s and All use the touchpad.
To control %1$s or All, use the %2$s side as a touchpad. Move one finger to move the pointer; tap to click. Scroll in any direction with two fingers.
While a screen reader is active, use %1$s control instead.
Your previous areas return in %1$d seconds unless you save.

Move one finger to move the pointer; tap to click and double-tap to double-click. Hold still, then move to drag or keep holding for a long press. You can also tap, then press again and drag. Move two fingers together to scroll in any direction; spread or pinch them to zoom at the pointer. Apps decide which gestures they support.

The connection is taking longer than expected. Check Shizuku, then try again.
Which side responds to touch when unfolded?

Choose the side of the inner screen that responds to touch. The controls and keyboard will appear on that side.\n\nYou can prepare on the cover screen with your phone folded. Unfold it when adjusting the screen areas.
Shall we patch the usable screen areas together?

FoldPatch leaves the broken center empty and shows your apps across both usable sides. This needs a separate app called Shizuku. We will guide you through installation and permissions.\n\nRead each permission explanation before allowing it. Start Shizuku again after restarting your phone.
Use the button below to open the official Shizuku download page and install it. Return to FoldPatch after installation to continue.\n\nShizuku and FoldPatch are made by different developers.

Use the button below to open About phone.

On a Galaxy, open Software information and tap Build number seven times. Unlock your phone if prompted.

Return to FoldPatch and tap Done · Next. If Developer options are already on, you can continue now. Menu names may vary by device.

Connect to a trusted Wi-Fi network, such as your home network.

Tap Open Developer options and turn on Wireless debugging. If asked, allow debugging on this Wi-Fi network.

Return to FoldPatch and tap Done · Next. We do not recommend doing this on public Wi-Fi.

1. Open Shizuku and tap Pairing under Start via Wireless debugging. Allow notifications if prompted.

2. Follow Shizuku’s instructions to open Pair device with pairing code in Wireless debugging settings. Enter the displayed code in the Shizuku notification.

3. Return to Shizuku and tap Start. When it says it is running, return to FoldPatch.

If already paired, just tap Start. If the pairing notification disappears, open Pairing in Shizuku again. Enter the code only in Shizuku; FoldPatch does not receive or store it.

Tap Allow connection below to open the Shizuku permission dialog. Allow FoldPatch to rearrange the screen and send touch input. You can revoke this permission in Shizuku at any time.\n\nIf the dialog does not appear after a previous denial, open Shizuku and enable FoldPatch in Authorized applications.
Permission is allowed. Please wait while FoldPatch connects to Shizuku.\n\nIf this screen stays open, check that Shizuku is running. Then return and tap Check Shizuku.
Keep controls visible over other apps
The Display over other apps permission lets you use the controls while another app is open.\n\nUse the button below to open settings, turn on permission for FoldPatch, then return here.

When you start FoldPatch, FoldPatch uses Shizuku to enable its accessibility service. It displays the adjusted screen and handles touch gestures.

It does not retrieve other apps’ text or accessibility content. Screen images are processed on your phone and are not saved or sent to a server.

Stop FoldPatch before turning the service off in system Accessibility settings. Stopping FoldPatch restores the display, but does not remove this permission.

While FoldPatch is active, Shizuku enables and selects the FoldPatch keyboard on your working side. Typed text goes to the selected input field in any app; FoldPatch does not save it or send it to a server.\n\nFolding the phone or stopping FoldPatch restores your previous keyboard. You can change keyboards in system settings.

Now unfold your phone in portrait orientation and unlock it.

1. Tap Turn on FoldPatch. When the button changes to Adjust screen areas, tap it again.

2. On the ruler screen, use the sliders and − / + buttons to set the visible width on each side.

3. Tap Preview, check the result, then tap Save these areas. Without saving, the previous areas return after 15 seconds.
This step needs the inner screen. Unfold your phone in portrait orientation and unlock it.

The controls below are for practice. Tap the handle to cycle through one button → selected buttons → all buttons.\n\nIn everyday use, select the opposite side or %1$s to use the working side as a touchpad.
You can now use FoldPatch with your usual apps.\n\nIf Shizuku stops, we will show you how to start it again. You do not need to adjust your saved screen areas again.
Turn on notifications to open FoldPatch settings by tapping its notification. FoldPatch also works without notifications.
Continue from the setup step where you left off.
Developer options are not enabled yet. Open About phone, tap Build number 7 times, then return here.

Shizuku has stopped. Use the button below to open Shizuku and tap Start. When it says it is running, return to FoldPatch.

You may need to connect to trusted Wi-Fi and turn on Wireless debugging to start it. If Shizuku requests pairing, follow its instructions.

Your screen areas and FoldPatch settings are still saved.
